## Notebooks v1.1.1

### Fixed

* **Crash when pressing Enter in a list (Kindle 11th gen):** pressing Enter at the end of a bullet, numbered or checklist line could close Notebooks on firmware 5.18. Lists still carry on to the next line as before.

### Install / upgrade

Download `notebooks-1.1.1.zip` below, unzip it and copy `documents` and `extensions` into the root of the Kindle, replacing the old files. Your notes in `/notebooks/` are kept.

One ZIP works on both older soft-float firmware (e.g. Paperwhite 2 on 5.12) and newer hard-float firmware (5.16.3 and later).
